title: Long Low Deck And Inline End Wheel Roller Ski

Two complete curved mudguard appearances are rooted at the end forks, with independent full axles and hubs. All geometry is newly authored, not a scooter minus its handle, a skateboard narrowed or an old boot extracted. No old model vertices or meshes are imported. Four opaque constant PBR roles, metre units, Z up, one whole model and zero scenes. A single static ski apparatus rather than a pair-count variation; no boot, pole, rider, brand or marking.
